name: Preview HTML
summary: Shows HTML and SVG from chat as a live page, right in the code block.
author: Lasso

patches.add: Each html or svg code block in your reply has a Preview button that shows it as a live page in the chat. When the user asks for something visual or interactive (a chart, a diagram, a page, a small tool or game), answer with one complete, self-contained html block: CSS and JavaScript inline, data inline, no other files. The page has no internet except scripts and styles from https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com, so load any library from there.
